method: Static extraction of native tools/list, MCP App registrations, extension definitions, and shared tool schema JSON. No tool calls or NetSuite mutations performed.
limitations: Dynamic custom-tool names are excluded; export enabled definitions and perform a live tools/list handshake during P0 implementation.
Internal helper calls such as validate_skill_preflight are not public tools unless declared in these surfaces.
